snippet.title: Good Hands - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446460/Good_Hands/

In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with over 100 uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.
